recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞有雙葉核，胞質內密布大小一致、橘粉紅色、具折光性的粗大圓形顆粒，顆粒不遮蓋核，這就是嗜酸性球（eosinophil）；左側為淋巴球可作對照。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than a red cell with a bilobed nucleus and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, coarse, round, refractile orange-pink granules that do not obscure the nucleus
Adjacent lymphocyte with round nucleus and pale blue cytoplasm for size comparison
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact and focal stacking; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature eosinophil (arrow) with a bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm filled with uniform, coarse, refractile orange-pink granules. A small-to-medium lymphocyte lies adjacent. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophils have coarse dark purple-black granules of variable size that obscure the nucleus, rather than uniform orange-pink granules around a clearly visible bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are dark blue-purple and finer, in a neutrophil with three to five lobes, not orange refractile granules with a bilobed nucleus.
Eosinophilic myelocytes have a round non-segmented nucleus and a mixture of purplish immature and orange granules.
